context: Daichi gives Mei a small Valentine's gift back to her.
purpose: Husband returning sweet gesture to wife.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: Here, Mei — this is for you.
lines.style: Warm Kansai drawl, soft opening. Tender but not performative. Slight hesitation before offering, like he's been carrying this. Gentle pride in his voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ホワイトデー、ありがとう!
lines.en: White Day — thank you so much.
lines.style: Surprised delight breaking through carefully. Warm, genuine. Quick upswing on the opening, then settling into sincerity. Soft exhale of relief.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: I wanted to tell you — I love you.
lines.style: Kansai lilt grounding the honesty. Direct and unguarded. Slow pace, each word carrying weight. The kind of thing he doesn't say lightly, so he says it simply.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: That makes me so happy. Really.
lines.style: Quiet, overwhelmed for just a moment. Steady herself. Soft voice, eyes probably bright. Not performing gratitude — feeling it, completely.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: From now on — always like this.
lines.style: Promise more than statement. Kansai warmth steady underneath. Slow, deliberate. The small pause before 「always」 like he's cementing it. Tender conviction.
